## Summary

Describe the change and the user or maintenance problem it addresses.

## Change category

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security
- [ ] CI or maintenance

## Implementation details

Explain the important design decisions and affected areas.

## Verification

List the commands, tests, and manual checks performed. Be explicit about checks that were not run.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe data, API, runtime, configuration, security, or deployment impact. Write "None identified" only after reviewing these areas.

## Documentation

- [ ] README updated where public behavior changed
- [ ] Relevant guides updated
- [ ] Configuration examples updated without real secrets

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal data, or generated local files are committed.
- [ ] Error and edge cases have been considered.
- [ ] Tests or reproducible verification steps are included.
- [ ] Existing application behavior has not been changed unintentionally.
